jei.ryzergen.info.microreactor: Part of the microreactor: one Reactor Heart, two Reactor Machine Units and one Coolant Jacket, in a block 1 wide, 2 deep and 2 high (the heart can go anywhere in it). Hold a part to see an outline of where the rest go; placing the last snaps it into one machine. Break any part to take it apart.
jei.ryzergen.info.fission_station: Part of the fission power station, a round tower 12 blocks across and 11 high. Place the Station Control Core first: it shows an outline of every part, and if you give it the parts (by hand or pipe) it builds the station itself. Its ports are on the sides of the base: water and fuel go in on your left as you face the front, and energy and spent rods come out on your right.
jei.ryzergen.info.station_core: Goes in the fission station's core grid. Graphite blocks are moderators: fuel beside one makes 40% more heat at no extra burn. Control rods take 35% off the heat and burn of the fuel beside them, to tame a layout that runs too hot.
jei.ryzergen.info.fittings: Fits one side of a cable or pipe, in its panel (right-click the cable with an empty hand). It raises the limit for what comes in on that side: pulled by an extract side, pushed in by a generator, or drawn from a battery. Silver 8x, Busbar 32x, Cryogenic 1024x. Each tier is crafted from the one before.
jei.ryzergen.info.spent_fuel_pool: Part of the Spent Fuel Pool, 5 blocks long, 3 wide and 3 high. Place the Pool Controller on the ground: it shows an outline, and if you give it 43 Pool Liner and a Pool Crane (by hand or pipe) it builds the pool itself, then moves up into the middle of the front. Fill it with water. Spent fuel comes out of reactors hot and must cool in its 18 racks before the Core Cracker or Reprocessor will take it: a depleted core in %s minutes, a spent rod in %s. Decay heat boils the water off, so keep it topped up. Hot fuel and water go in on the left end as you face it, and cooled fuel comes out on the right.
jei.ryzergen.info.spent_fuel_pool_option: Part of the Spent Fuel Pool, 5 blocks long, 3 wide and 3 high. Place the Pool Controller on the ground: it shows an outline, and if you give it 43 Pool Liner and a Pool Crane (by hand or pipe) it builds the pool itself. Fuel cooling is turned off in this pack's config, so spent fuel can go straight to the Core Cracker or Reprocessor and the pool is only for show.
jei.ryzergen.info.container_battery: Part of the Container Battery, 8 blocks long, 3 wide and 3 high. Place the Battery Controller on the ground: it shows an outline, and if you give it 70 Container Frame and a Thermal Unit (by hand or pipe) it builds the container itself. Right-click an LFP Battery Rack into one of its 20 front hatches: each rack holds %s FE and moves %s FE/t, so a full container holds %s FE and moves %s FE/t. Shift-right-click a hatch with an empty hand to take its rack out, charge and all. Both energy ports on the back take energy in or give it out, so your cables decide the flow. Coolant goes in at the fan's hub; without it the racks run at a quarter of their rate.
jei.ryzergen.info.steam: Steam. The microreactor boils its coolant into steam while it runs with water: %s mB of water a tick becomes %s mB of steam (%s into %s in overdrive). Pipe it from the steam outlet to anything that runs on steam (it is tagged c:steam). The fission station boils water too, but into its own roof turbine: it drinks water and gives out power, not steam.

progression.ryzergen.title: Ryzer Gen: from the ground to the sun
progression.ryzergen.hint: Drag or scroll to move along the line. Click a step to read about it.
progression.ryzergen.column.more_hint: The breeder, fusion and the Dyson swarm are still being built.
progression.ryzergen.grid.uranium_power: Uranium, most power (as the control screen shows it, front row at the bottom)
progression.ryzergen.iron.info.1: Mined from iron ore. Steel, frames and most early recipes start here.
progression.ryzergen.coal.info.1: Carbon: for steel and silicon, and a block of coal in a blast furnace bakes into graphite.
progression.ryzergen.copper.info.1: Wire for cables, boards and the coolant jacket.
progression.ryzergen.sand.info.1: Silica: with graphite it makes silicon carbide, and with coal in the electric smelter, silicon.
progression.ryzergen.redstone.info.1: Control logic for circuit boards, cables and machines.
progression.ryzergen.gold.info.1: Contacts on advanced control boards and speed modules.
progression.ryzergen.uranium.info.1: The fuel of every reactor tier. Deep and uncommon. Safe to carry: only running reactors give off radiation.
progression.ryzergen.lead.info.1: Radiation shielding: the reactor heart, the Reprocessor and the station's core.
progression.ryzergen.silver.info.1: Soaks up neutrons: the fission station's control rods. Also silver cable fittings.
progression.ryzergen.salt.info.1: Lithium for batteries and tritium, and sodium for the breeder's coolant.
Your first machine. It burns furnace fuel to alloy two ingredients: steel and silicon carbide.
progression.ryzergen.steel.info.1: Iron and coal in the alloy smelter. The backbone of every machine and multiblock.
progression.ryzergen.graphite.info.1: A block of coal in a blast furnace gives 3. Fuel packing, TRISO coating, and the station's moderator.
progression.ryzergen.silicon_carbide.inf: Sand and graphite in the alloy smelter (the Acheson process). It coats TRISO fuel.
progression.ryzergen.basic_board.info.1: Redstone, copper and iron. It runs the first machines.
Smelted from raw uranium. Every fuel starts as one.
progression.ryzergen.triso.info.1: Uranium kernels coated in graphite and silicon carbide. The Fuel Fabricator presses 3 per uranium, the crafting grid only 2.
progression.ryzergen.fuel_core.info.1: TRISO pellets sealed in graphite and steel: one load for the microreactor, about 40 minutes.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.info.1: Four blocks: the reactor heart, two machine units and a coolant jacket. Your first real power.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.info.2: Dry it makes 200 FE/t. Water through the jacket raises it to about 257 FE/t, and the steam can be piped away.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.info.3: A spent core comes out depleted: the start of the fuel cycle.
progression.ryzergen.intake_pump.info.1: Sits one block above water and draws 100 mB/t for 10 FE/t, never draining the source.
progression.ryzergen.energy_cable.info.1: Carries power. Wrench a side to make it pull or push.
progression.ryzergen.electric_smelter.in: The alloy smelter on power, hot enough to make silicon.
progression.ryzergen.silicon.info.1: Sand and coal in the electric alloy smelter only: it takes an arc furnace's heat.
progression.ryzergen.advanced_board.info: Silicon, steel and gold. The key component of tier 2 and above.
progression.ryzergen.core_cracker.info.1: Crushes depleted fuel cores open: spent kernels out, with graphite and steel back.
progression.ryzergen.pool.info.1: Spent fuel comes out of a reactor hot. The pool cools it before the Core Cracker or Reprocessor will take it.
progression.ryzergen.reprocessor.info.1: Spent kernels or rods, with fluorite and water: uranium back, plutonium nuggets, and waste for the cask.
progression.ryzergen.plutonium.info.1: Nine nuggets make an ingot. A spent uranium rod gives 3, a microreactor core 1.
progression.ryzergen.fuel_fabricator.inf: Presses fuel: uranium rods, MOX rods, TRISO pellets and, later, breeder fuel. The recipe with the most ingredients wins.
progression.ryzergen.uranium_rod.info.1: 2 uranium and a steel. 1,000 thermal FE/t for 30 minutes in the station.
progression.ryzergen.mox_rod.info.1: Plutonium, uranium and steel. Twice the heat of uranium, and it lasts 2 hours.
progression.ryzergen.control_rod.info.1: Silver in steel. It slows the fuel beside it, to trim a hot layout.
progression.ryzergen.station.info.1: Tier 3's power station. Plan its 5 x 5 core of fuel, graphite, control rods and coolant on the control screen.
progression.ryzergen.station.info.2: Coolant is local: each rod's heat goes to the coolant channels touching it. Graphite beside fuel adds heat without burning more fuel.
progression.ryzergen.station.info.3: It drinks a lot of water: feed it with intake pumps.
progression.ryzergen.lithium_extractor.i: Salt and water into lithium: battery racks now, tritium later.
progression.ryzergen.container_battery.i: A grid-scale battery: a container of LFP racks, built round its controller.
progression.ryzergen.electrorefiner.info: Tier 4's molten salt cell. It needs fission power: 1,500 FE/t, every tick, or no progress.
Spent MOX into transuranic metal, salt into sodium, and sodium ingots into liquid sodium.
progression.ryzergen.transuranic.info.1: Plutonium, americium and curium together, plated out of spent MOX. The breeder's fuel.
progression.ryzergen.sodium.info.1: Split from salt, then melted into liquid sodium for the breeder's loop (4,000 mB fills it).
progression.ryzergen.breeder_fuel.info.1: Transuranic metal, uranium and 2 steel in the Fuel Fabricator. The only fuel that starts a breeder.
progression.ryzergen.uranium_blanket.inf: 2 uranium and a steel. Round the breeder's fuel it breeds plutonium for MOX rods.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.1: Tier 4: a sodium-cooled fast reactor. Plan its 19-position hex core with fuel, control rods and blankets.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.2: The sodium cools the whole core: set the pumps' flow to carry the heat with little to spare.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.3: No assembly may pass 13,000 heat, the hot spot limit. It needs spent MOX to stay fuelled, so keep your station running.
progression.ryzergen.tritium.info.1: Lithium target rods in the breeder's blanket breed tritium, the fuel that starts fusion.
progression.ryzergen.fusion.info.1: Tier 5: a tokamak, fed with tritium from the breeder. Still being built.
progression.ryzergen.swarm.info.1: Tier 6: a Dyson swarm round a walkable sun. The end of the line, standing on everything before it.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.spoile: Most power: water-cooled with the safeties off (overdrive), about 460 FE/t, for double the water and 30% faster fuel burn.
Keep the water coming in overdrive: lose it and the core runs away in about 9 seconds.
Set excess power to Dump and it keeps burning fuel into depleted cores with nothing to power, which feeds the fuel cycle.
progression.ryzergen.reprocessor.spoiler: One Reprocessor and one Fuel Fabricator keep up with a whole station; add Speed Modules if you fall behind.
3 spent uranium rods give one MOX rod's plutonium.
progression.ryzergen.station.spoiler.1: Uranium, most power: 8,006 FE/t from 15 rods at 544°C. Most energy per rod: 2,713 FE/t from just 4 rods, twice the energy each.
progression.ryzergen.station.spoiler.2: MOX, most power: about 16,000 FE/t, close to the uranium layout doubled.
progression.ryzergen.station.spoiler.3: Overdrive adds about half as much power again. Keep every fuel channel filled or the flux tilts.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.spoiler.1: Most power: 38,000 FE/t at 100% flow, from exactly 100,000 heat (the loop's limit).
progression.ryzergen.breeder.spoiler.2: Pack the fuel to burn least (9 assemblies an hour, about 10 blankets bred), or spread it to breed twice as much (about 20 an hour, for 9.5 assemblies).
